description: Main ingestion script to seed/update a database from spreadsheets and role card text files for a career path planning system, handling roles, competencies, adjacency, and role cards.

classes.name: SupabaseClient
classes.description: A simple REST client for Supabase, used to perform upsert and selection operations for database tables.

methods.name: load_env()
methods.description: Loads environment variables for Supabase URL and service role key, ensuring they are available.

methods.name: str slugify_code(name: str)
methods.description: Generates a code/slug from a role name, using known aliases or extracting acronym within parentheses.

methods.name: Optional[str] norm_text(s: Optional[str])
methods.description: Normalizes text by stripping whitespace and converting empty strings to None.

methods.name: str map_level(val: Any)
methods.description: Maps a competency level string to a standardized level ('beginner', 'intermediate', 'advanced').

methods.name: Optional[str] find_col(df: pd.DataFrame, key: str)
methods.description: Finds a column in a DataFrame matching a key or its variants.

methods.name: Dict[str,Dict[str,Any]] ensure_roles(client: SupabaseClient, names_with_desc: Dict[str, Optional[str]])
methods.description: Upserts roles into the database and returns a mapping of role names/codes to role records.

methods.name: Dict[str,Dict[str,Any]] ensure_competencies(client: SupabaseClient, entries: Dict[Tuple[str, Optional[str]], Dict[str, Optional[str]]])
methods.description: Upserts competencies into the database and returns a mapping of competency names to records.

methods.name: upsert_role_competencies(client: SupabaseClient, rc_rows: list)
methods.description: Performs bulk upsert of role-competency relationships.

methods.name: upsert_role_adjacency(client: SupabaseClient, edges: list)
methods.description: Performs bulk upsert of role adjacency (relationship) edges.

methods.name: upsert_role_cards(client: SupabaseClient, cards: list)
methods.description: Performs bulk upsert of role card information.

methods.name: pd.DataFrame parse_competency_mapping(path: str)
methods.description: Parses an Excel file containing competency mappings.

methods.name: pd.DataFrame parse_role_adjacency(path: str)
methods.description: Parses an Excel file containing role adjacency matrices.

methods.name: pd.DataFrame parse_role_navigator(path: str)
methods.description: Parses an Excel worksheet with role navigator details.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] parse_role_card_text(path: str)
methods.description: Parse role card text files into structured sections and raw text.

methods.name: str start_ingestion_run(client: SupabaseClient, src: str)
methods.description: Initiates an ingestion run record in the database to track progress.

methods.name: finish_ingestion_run(client: SupabaseClient, run_id: str, status: str, processed: int, upserted: int, error: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Completes the ingestion run record in the database, logging status and metrics.

methods.name: __init__(self, base_url: str, service_key: str)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: main()
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: select(self, table: str, query: str = "*", filters: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: upsert(self, table: str, rows: Any, on_conflict: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: unavailable
